subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Clawback Provisions
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Clawback Provisions.

hook.text: A CEO earns $50 million in bonuses based on fake results. After the fraud is discovered, can you get the money back?

buildup.text: Clawback provisions require executives to return compensation tied to results later found to be fraudulent.

discovery.text: Dodd-Frank mandated clawback policies. The SEC finalized rules in 2023 requiring all listed companies to adopt them.

twist.text: Clawbacks apply even if the executive didn't commit the fraud. Restatements trigger automatic recovery.

climax.text: Clawbacks remove the profit motive from fraud. If you can't keep the gains, the incentive shrinks.

punchline.text: Earn bonuses on fake numbers. Give them back. Clawback.

quiz.question: What are clawback provisions?
options: Rules requiring return of pay based on fraudulent results
